Storyboard: Bridging the Gap: From Innovation to Patient Impact

Ethics, Evidence, Regulation and Responsible Medical Device Translation · Dr Vikas Kumar Jha · KIIT University, Bhubaneswar · 40-min core 39:30 · full 70:00

Story spine. Two composite patients, Ramesh (Parkinson's, freezing of gait, FoGO) and Kamala (knee osteoarthritis, SwaKnee), followed along six stages: Need → Evidence → People → Permission → Access → Safety. Permission is the deep module: regulation in India by risk class, CDSCO obligations and guidance, then the comparison abroad.
Two paths. 40-minute workshop: the 24 slides flagged core (39.50 min scripted): every vote and decision, the FoGO and SwaKnee evidence, risk classes, the licence matrix, FoGO's path, the quiz, the world map and the India–USA–EU comparison · 75-minute seminar: all 54 main slides (70 min scripted), with the full regulatory deep-dive
